integration_highlights.semrush: All-in-one marketing toolkit - 10M+ users worldwide for SEO, PPC, content marketing, and competitive research

seo_competitor_analysis.description: Comprehensive SEO and competitor analysis with Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Notion
flow: Ahrefs: Get domain rating and backlink profile for target domain
SEMrush: Get organic search positions and keyword rankings
Ahrefs: Analyze top performing pages and content gaps
SEMrush: Run competitor analysis to identify organic competitors
Ahrefs: Get backlink gap analysis vs top 3 competitors
SEMrush: Analyze PPC keywords and ad strategies
Ahrefs: Site audit to identify technical SEO issues
SEMrush: Core Web Vitals and page speed analysis
Notion: Create comprehensive SEO report with findings
Slack: Notify marketing team with actionable insights and priorities

marketing_automation_zapier.description: Multi-app marketing automation with Zapier, Mailchimp, and ActiveCampaign
flow: Zapier: Create Zap triggered by website form submission
Zapier: Parse form data (name, email, company, interest)
ActiveCampaign: Create or update contact with form details
ActiveCampaign: Score lead based on company size and interest
Zapier: Route high-score leads (>75) to sales path
Zapier: Route low-score leads (<50) to nurture path
Mailchimp: Add nurture leads to welcome email sequence
ActiveCampaign: Create deal for hot leads in 'New Lead' stage
Slack: Notify sales team of qualified leads with contact details
Zapier: Log all actions to Google Sheets for tracking

advanced_workflow_make.description: Advanced e-commerce order processing with Make, Shopify, and QuickBooks
flow: Make: Trigger on new Shopify order webhook
Make: Iterator to process each line item in order
Shopify: Check inventory levels for each product
Make: Router with 3 paths based on inventory status
Make Path 1 (In Stock): Proceed with fulfillment
Make Path 2 (Low Stock): Create reorder task in Asana
Make Path 3 (Out of Stock): Send customer backorder email
QuickBooks: Create invoice for in-stock orders
Shopify: Create fulfillment and mark as shipped
Twilio: Send SMS order confirmation to customer
Make: Aggregate daily orders for reporting
QuickBooks: Record revenue and update inventory value
Make: Handle errors with retry and fallback to manual queue

keyword_research_workflow.description: Comprehensive keyword research with Ahrefs, SEMrush, and Google Sheets
flow: Ahrefs: Get keyword ideas for seed keyword (e.g., 'project management')
Ahrefs: Filter by search volume (>1000) and keyword difficulty (<40)
SEMrush: Get related keywords and question-based variations
SEMrush: Analyze keyword difficulty and CPC data
Ahrefs: Get top-ranking pages for each target keyword
SEMrush: Analyze content gaps vs competitors
Zapier: Combine data from Ahrefs + SEMrush into unified dataset
Zapier: Calculate priority score (volume × relevance / difficulty)
Notion: Create content calendar with prioritized keyword targets
Zapier: Export keyword list to Google Sheets for team access

content_distribution_automation.description: Automated content distribution with Make, multiple platforms, and tracking
flow: Make: Trigger on new blog post published in Notion content calendar
Notion: Extract post metadata (title, summary, tags, featured image)
Make: Router to distribute content across channels
Make Path 1: Social media posting
Make Path 2: Email newsletter to Mailchimp list
Make Path 3: Update HubSpot blog and notify subscribers
Make Path 4: Post to LinkedIn company page
Mailchimp: Create email campaign with blog post content
HubSpot: Create blog article and publish
Make: Aggregate engagement metrics after 24 hours
Notion: Update content calendar with performance data
Slack: Daily digest of content performance and top posts
